_context.description: "Issue" is the work item of a project (German: Ticket), never a coworker's scheduled task, which the app already calls a task.
_context.mine: Badge on an item the reader created or whose project they lead.
_context.tabs.conversations: Conversations with AI coworkers that stopped to ask the reader something (an approval, a question, a connection).
_context.handed.finished: {name} is the person or AI coworker who moved the issue to review.
_context.asks: What a coworker conversation is waiting on, shown as a badge.

title: Review
description: Work your coworkers hand back for a look.
noComment: No comment yet. Open the issue to see what was done.
noReason: No reason given. Open the issue to see what it needs.

toasts.changesRequested: {ref} went back to work with your comment

requestChanges.title: Request changes on {ref}
requestChanges.description: Say what to change. Your comment is posted on the issue, then it goes back to In progress.
requestChanges.label: What should change
requestChanges.placeholder: The menu needs the brand colors, and the search field should come first.

unblock.title: Unblock {ref}
unblock.description: The issue goes back to Todo. Add a comment if whoever picks it up needs to know what changed.
unblock.label: Comment
unblock.placeholder: The export of the old CMS is in the shared folder.

loadFailed: The review queue could not be loaded

allClear.title: Nothing waits on you
allClear.description: When a coworker finishes an issue, gets blocked or asks you something, it shows up here.

toReview.title: Nothing to review
toReview.description: When a coworker or a teammate moves an issue to In review, it waits here for your look.

blocked.title: Nothing is blocked
blocked.description: An issue that cannot move on shows up here, with the reason and who must do what.

conversations.title: No conversation waits on you
conversations.description: When a coworker stops to ask for an approval, an answer or a connection, the conversation shows up here.
